festivals.name: Rann Utsav (White Desert Festival)
festivals.description: 4-month cultural carnival in Dhordo tent city featuring folk dance, music, crafts, and full-moon desert nights.

festivals.name: Gujarat Navratri Garba Mahotsav
festivals.description: The world's longest dance festival with night-long Garba dance celebrations across Gujarat cities.

festivals.name: International Kite Festival (Uttarayan)
festivals.description: Sky filled with thousands of vibrant kites, rooftop music celebrations, and undhiyu/jalebi traditional feast.
